```{python}
from collections import Counter
from goatools.obo_parser import GODag
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

```{python}
# --- CONFIG ---
go_obo_file = "/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/FeatureCounts_w_brakerGTF/go.obo"
go_term_file = "/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/FeatureCounts_w_brakerGTF/sig_up_DEGs_none_vs_high_w_eggNOG_GOs_filtered.txt"  # 2-column: gene<TAB>GO:xxxx,GO:xxxx,...
output_csv = "/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/FeatureCounts_w_brakerGTF/sig_up_DEGs_none_vs_high_go_term_counts.csv"
plot_file = "/Users/oliver/Desktop/RNASeq_2025/FeatureCounts_w_brakerGTF/sig_up_DEGs_none_vs_high_go_term_plot.png"
top_n = 20  # Number of GO terms to plot
```

```{python}
# --- LOAD GO DAG ---
print("Loading GO DAG...")
go_dag = GODag(go_obo_file)

# --- COUNT GO TERMS ---
print("Counting GO terms...")
go_counts = Counter()

with open(go_term_file) as f:
    for line in f:
        cols = line.strip().split("\t")
        if len(cols) == 2 and cols[1]:
            go_terms = cols[1].split(",")
            for go in go_terms:
                go_counts[go.strip()] += 1
```

```{python}
# --- BUILD DATAFRAME ---
print("Building GO term table...")
data = []
for go_term, count in go_counts.items():
    if go_term in go_dag:
        name = go_dag[go_term].name
        namespace = go_dag[go_term].namespace
    else:
        name = "NA"
        namespace = "NA"
    data.append((go_term, name, namespace, count))

df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=["GO_ID", "Name", "Namespace", "Count"])
df.sort_values("Count", ascending=False, inplace=True)

# --- SAVE CSV ---
print(f"Saving to {output_csv}")
df.to_csv(output_csv, index=False)
```

```{python}
# --- PLOT ---
print(f"Plotting top {top_n} GO terms...")
df_top = df.head(top_n)
colors = {"biological_process": "lightblue", "molecular_function": "lightgreen", "cellular_component": "lightcoral"}

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
bars = plt.barh(df_top["Name"], df_top["Count"],
                color=[colors.get(ns, "gray") for ns in df_top["Namespace"]])
plt.xlabel("GO Term Count")
plt.title(f"Top {top_n} GO Terms in DEGs")
plt.gca().invert_yaxis()  # Highest on top
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(plot_file)
print(f"Plot saved to {plot_file}")
plt.show()
```
